brand.disclaimer: Unofficial fan companion — not affiliated with DWP or Louder Than Life

promptRules: One subject, one action per clip
No split-screen, no in-clip cuts, no composited text

sourceVideos2025: Louder Than Life 2025 official recap (DWP / YouTube)
Crowd/stage B-roll matching Kentucky Expo Center outdoor festival
User POV phone footage style from 2025 attendance if available

shots.cinematography: 9:16 vertical handheld POV, 24mm wide, slow push-in toward the phone
shots.subjectAction: One festival-goer in a black band shirt holds a smartphone and scrolls a map app, brow furrowed, walking forward through crowd
shots.environment: Outdoor rock festival at golden hour, Kentucky expo fairgrounds, distant ferris wheel, hazy orange stage glow, dense metal crowd
shots.lightingStyle: Cinematic UGC, gritty, high contrast, shallow depth of field on phone screen
shots.audio: Muffled distant drums, crowd chatter, one sharp notification ping at 4 seconds
shots.constraints: No readable artist names on stages. No DWP logos. Leave empty space in top third for text overlay.
